name: Muddy Note
summary: A muddy, barely legible note found among a strongbox’s valuables. Its details about Private Thorsen’s patrols may help Lieutenant Doren uncover a traitor at Rebel Camp.

sections.title: The Scribbled Note
sections.body: Private Thorsen’s patrol routes and habits are set down in a muddy note from a strongbox in Stranglethorn Vale. It also records who he speaks with among the rebels. The writing is hard to read, but Lieutenant Doren needs the note to find the traitor.

faq.q: What does the muddy note say?
faq.answer: The note records Private Thorsen’s patrol routes, his conversations, and how he spends his time with the rebels. Its writing is barely legible.

faq.q: Where do I take the note?
faq.answer: Take the muddy note to Lieutenant Doren at Rebel Camp.
The note is signed with the single letter M. It does not identify its writer by name.
The note shows that its writer knew Private Thorsen’s routines and dealings. Lieutenant Doren needs it as a clue to find the traitor among the rebels.
